Fed & Policy Watch
  • Fed speakers are scheduled today and Thursday, including Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman and Chairman Warsh; remarks may move rates if policy-relevant, but no direction is implied.
  • Beige Book is scheduled today. The Board calendar says 2:00 PM ET; Chicago Fed release calendar specifies 3:00 PM ET and the same late-August/September reference period. Timing conflict remains unresolved; verify before relying on either time.
  • Thursday includes the 4:30 PM ET H.4.1 weekly balance-sheet release, plus Board H.15 and H.8 at 4:15 PM. Selected Fed statistical releases are listed, not every release.
  • SIFMA lists Columbus Day, Oct 12, as a U.S. fixed-income market holiday. Treasury's latest available daily curve is now Tuesday Oct 13: 10Y 5.21%, down 3 bp from Friday Oct 9.
  • Thursday's 8:30 AM cluster is Census retail sales, Chicago Fed NFCI and the Philadelphia Fed survey. EIA's holiday-adjusted petroleum report is Thursday at noon.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS was excluded by operator decision dated Oct 11, 2026; no BLS site or mirror was requested. CPI, PPI and other BLS releases are not verified or shown.
  • Conflict check: a prior calendar entry showed Existing-Home Sales for today, but NAR's current page says its latest release was Sep sales on Oct 13 and gives Nov 12 at 10:00 AM ET as the next release. The stale Oct 14 entry is omitted.
  • NY Fed Empire State Manufacturing Survey is listed for Oct 15, but the official page says release is "at or shortly after 8:30 a.m." and does not give an exact time; omitted from the timed calendar. EIA natural-gas schedule provided no verified date/time for Oct 14-20. BEA schedule check produced no verified release for this date range.
  • TreasuryDirect confirms auction dates for Oct 19 (13- and 26-week bills) and Oct 20 (6-week bill), but no cutoff times or offering amounts are posted; these are date-only. Oct 14 and Oct 15 bill cutoffs and offerings are verified in TreasuryDirect.
  • Material verified checks: Federal Reserve Board calendar and H.4.1, Chicago Fed calendar/NFCI, Census, TreasuryDirect, Treasury, NY Fed, Philadelphia Fed, EIA petroleum/natural gas, BEA, NAR, SIFMA and CME/Cboe link checks (CME page unavailable). No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; that is not a claim that no such risk exists.
  • Yahoo snapshot quotes are single-source. Generic futures prices are not official settlement values; confirm the active contract, current trading hours, depth and live prices before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Use the 00:51 ET ES=F quote only as overnight context. MOVE is in the moderate range; the latest official 10Y close is 5.21%. Focus on today's Beige Book (time disputed) and Thursday's 8:30 AM data cluster, Treasury bill supply and noon EIA report. Scenario framework only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break with confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth, or if the applicable contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or price targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes before execution.
